interface.shortDescription: Use your local OKF knowledge bundle in Codex
interface.longDescription: LLM Wiki for Codex connects Codex to the same local OKF v0.2 markdown bundle used by the DSH, Pi, MCP, and Skill forms. The plugin bundles a wiki skill, 14 wiki_* MCP tools, and lifecycle hooks that refresh the active bundle and per-directory APPEND_SYSTEM_PROMPT.md rules without duplicating knowledge.
